questions.question: After the Philistines captured the ark of God, they set it beside the statue of which god in Ashdod?
When the Philistines put God's ark beside their god's statue, what was broken off the statue by the second morning?
When tumors struck the Philistine city of Ashdod, what did its men decide about the ark of God?

answers.text: The ark must not stay with them
The ark must be given more honor
The ark must be hidden in the temple

questions.question: When the ark of the God of Israel arrived in the Philistine city of Ekron, what did the people cry out?

answers.text: It was brought here to kill us
It will bring our city great honor
It belongs beside our own god now
